# automq_environment

Creates and manages an AutoMQ environment in the AutoMQ Cloud Control Plane.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "automq_environment" "example" {
  name           = "production"
  description    = "Production environment"
  cloud_provider = "aws"
  region         = "us-east-1"
  scope          = "123456789012"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider code, such as `aws` or `gcp`.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `region` (String) Cloud region in which the environment is installed.
- `scope` (String) Cloud account scope, such as an AWS account ID or Google Cloud project ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Environment description.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client identifier generated when the environment is created. This value is not returned by subsequent read requests.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret generated when the environment is created. This value is not returned by subsequent read requests.
- `created_at` (String) Environment creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Environment identifier assigned by AutoMQ.
- `ops_bucket` (String) Operations bucket assigned to the environment.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier that owns the environment.
- `updated_at` (String) Environment update timestamp in RFC 3339 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import automq_environment.example env-xxxxx
```

After the import completes, run `terraform plan` to review any drift in optional arguments.
